Nepal Mourns Over 1,300 Killed in Devastating Floods

Nepal observed a national day of mourning, concluding a 13-day Hindu mourning period, following devastating floods that killed over 1,300 people. Search operations continued as priests, monks, and residents held prayer ceremonies on the banks of the Trishuli River for the deceased. Families also prayed for those still missing after the disaster.
